mapping_reviews.reason: Article 9 of the AI Act addresses the scope of the regulation and does not contain provisions related to data export, deletion, or system retirement.
Article 17, concerning data governance, includes requirements for data quality and management, which can support the control statement's focus on data deletion and export.
Article 26(5) pertains to the obligations of the provider regarding the AI system's conformity assessment and does not address data lifecycle management or system retirement.
Article 72 outlines the powers of the European Artificial Intelligence Board and does not contain provisions related to data export, deletion, or system retirement.

challenge_comment: The mapping to Article 17 is partially supported, but the other mappings are unsupported.
